integrity: The Gaussian normalization, shape Hessian, spherical-harmonic multiplier normalization, strict Bessel-order monotonicity, and endpoint expansions were reconstructed analytically. The accompanying checker supplies finite independent numerical normalization checks; no independent mathematical audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem proves the quadratic expansion for fixed smooth exactly equal-volume star-shaped families in every fixed even Euclidean dimension at least four. It does not give global nonlinear stability for arbitrary sets, a dimension-uniform remainder, or stability of individual localization eigenvalues. Uninspected equivalent older treatments remain a historical-priority risk.
title: Sharp spherical-harmonic stability of Gaussian localization purity in higher dimensions
